reason: I've got years of runs in Strava and my watch already logs everything, so I'm not running a second GPS app in parallel just to earn points I can't cash out and grow virtual shoes. The crew-run part only works if the whole Saturday group installs it, and half of them are on iPhones.
objection: Two GPS apps going at once will kill my battery, and I don't know if its distances will even match my watch. On top of that, the shoe-gacha points thing feels like a game for kids, not a running tool.
would_change_my_mind: If it pulled my runs straight from Strava or my watch so I never had to start it separately, and it came to iPhone so my whole crew could actually use the crew features together.
